repairs_this_round.R1: The only production change allowed by the card, in Contracts/MediaPackageContracts.cs: MediaPackageIssueSink.Record called `recorded.Add(...)` BEFORE the capacity test, so every new distinct pair entered the HashSet before the sink noticed there was no room, and the insertion was never undone. Measured on the previous candidate with cap = 1 and 10000 distinct locations: 1 public issue, IsTruncated = true, and a private dedup store holding 10000 keys, so the bounded-memory guarantee had been rolled back while the comment and the report still claimed every internal store stayed within the cap. Record now does a pure `recorded.Contains((code, location))` lookup first (a repeat returns false and is not a truncation), then the cap test, which for a new pair with no room left only sets IsTruncated and stores the pair NOWHERE, and only a pair that is actually reported is added to the dedup store together with its issue. Both internal stores and the public list therefore hold at most MaximumIssues entries, order is still first-occurrence, the views are still read-only, the frozen vocabulary is untouched and Record keeps its boolean meaning. The class comment now states the real invariant.
repairs_this_round.R2: The single test the coordinator's real run failed was building invalid JSON. MediaPackageBoundaryTests.DuplicateDeclaredPathsAreRejectedByTheReader did a string Replace that spliced a whole object into the PROPERTY LIST, producing `"path":"poster.png",{"cid":null,...`, which is not JSON, so the reader refused the document as invalid_manifest and the duplicate_path assertion failed. The test now parses the real fixture with JsonNode, keeps the existing poster object in the files ARRAY and APPENDS a complete Poster.PNG object built from that entry's own kind, size_bytes and sha256, so two paths that differ only in case are really declared. Before calling the reader it re-parses the produced bytes and asserts both paths are present and the array grew by exactly one entry, so a malformed document can no longer be mistaken for a duplicate-path refusal. The product was not adjusted for the broken fixture.
repairs_this_round.R3: The round-3 escape regressions never tested a surrogate escape: they handed the TEXT `\uD800` to a JsonNode and serialized it, and the serializer escaped the backslash again, so the reader received `5c 5c 75 44 38 30 30` (an escaped backslash followed by the letters uD800) instead of `5c 75 44 38 30 30`. That is why the old assertions could only claim 'some frozen code', which let an identity or path refusal masquerade as the syntax guard. The tests now use MutateWithRawEscape: the mutation writes a unique ASCII placeholder token, the document is serialized normally, and the placeholder is replaced in the FINAL BYTES, so the reader receives a real single-backslash escape. Each case asserts that byte shape FIRST and then the exact verdict: the frozen invalid_manifest code with the surrogate_escape reason and no field-level code, for a lone high half, a lone low half and the concatenated `\uD800XDC00`, in a bvid value, a file path and a property NAME, with no framework exception escaping. The contrast test builds three genuinely different byte samples -- the legal pair `\uD83D\uDE00`, the same character as raw UTF-8, and an escaped backslash followed by the literal uD800 -- asserts the differences, asserts none reports surrogate_escape, and asserts the escaped pair and the UTF-8 spelling produce the SAME field-semantic diagnostic. The raw digest is recomputed over the final bytes. The native ManifestReader was neither changed nor reverted to a scanner.
repairs_this_round.R4: The existing failure test only replaced the root with a file BEFORE the run, so the final re-check of the trusted root was exercised by a runtime probe only. The new test TargetRootReplacedByAFileAfterTheFirstHashIsRefused composes the real preflight with a thin decorator that delegates every hash to the real MediaPackageFileHasher and then acts after the first hash returns; that action deletes the empty target root and writes a regular file in its place. The real Inspector must reject with unsafe_path, must not return Inspected, must not claim target_exists, must report zero verified files, and every location must stay relative with no absolute path. The test first proves the destructive step touches only its own sandbox. The wrapper enters through MediaPackageSandbox.ComposeWithHasher, so neither the product port nor the Inspector changed. The R1 sink regression is covered by IssueSinkKeepsEveryInternalStoreBoundedAtTheCap, which counts the private collections read-only through reflection instead of inferring the memory bound from the public issue list, because the card forbids adding a production observation interface for it.
repairs_this_round.R5: The six tracking documents are rewritten against this round's real state. They distinguish the previous round's REAL product defect (the target root replaced by a regular file, closed by that round's inspector fix) from its test-construction errors, and record the one-byte read-budget change as an adjacent construction correction rather than a seventh failure -- the earlier claim that all six failures were test problems was false and is corrected. Every claim that MediaPackageIssueSink was reused unchanged is removed, since it is the file this round repairs, and the internal-bound claim is stated only now that R1 makes it true, with measured counts. The isolated-surrogate field refusals are no longer presented as decode-rejection evidence. File counts, candidate rounds and the real executed/skipped numbers come from the final state, the long-file observation stays an unauthorised deviation with no invented exemption, and no unperformed gate is written as passed. delivery.json embeds no hash array at all: source_snapshot is the string `.runtime/dsh-delivery/source-snapshot.json`, and working_tree_clean is honestly false.

technical_debt: MediaPackageIssueSink now refuses a new pair past the cap BEFORE storing anything, so both the dedup store and the code list are bounded by MaximumIssues; the regression that pins this counts the private collections through reflection, which is test-side coupling to a private field name and would need updating if the sink's internals are renamed.

IsolatedMediaPackageInspector retains each observed file's length and last-write stamp in a private record and re-observes the target and its trusted parent at the end of the run, so a same-size rewrite and a target root replaced by a file are both refused rather than reported as inspected.

MediaPackageManifestReader decides string well-formedness by making the JSON reader decode every property name and string value; a decode failure becomes invalid_manifest@surrogate_escape and the framework exception is discarded.
MaximumEnumeratedEntries (4096) remains a constant rather than a configurable limit, so an oversized staging directory fails with budget_exceeded instead of a tuned path.
Several CA1506 suppressions carry written justifications; they can be reclaimed once a composition root exists.
